Mt.Moonspell is the first and only stage in the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked upon owning the DLC.
Ancestral home of a fallen clan, now overrun by yokai and oni. In this world where the sun doesn't shine, the night is victorious.
The hyper mode for this stage can be unlocked by defeating Orochimario (25:00) in normal mode.

Defeating the Orochimario unlocks the stage's hyper mode.
Orochimario spawns with eight heads, the first head has double the health to be 1,000★ and each head adds its own health to Orochimario, which means its total health is actually 5,000★. When they take damage, Orochimario itself also take that much, they can be individually defeated. The heads can lunge at the player to attack them every 5 to 10 s.
